meta.title: Basmet Dawah: a guided path for new Muslims
meta.description: Answer six short questions to find your starting point, then learn Islam one short lesson at a time, in the right order. Free, in English, Arabic, and Spanish.

hero.lead: Answer six gentle questions and we will choose your stage, your path, and your first lesson.

welcome.lead: Your place is saved. Pick up right where you left off.

ready.lead: Start with the first lesson whenever you feel ready. Each one takes only a few minutes.
ready.fallback: Paths for your stage are being prepared, so this is the best place to begin for now.

one.title: Answer six questions
one.body: Tell us where you are with wudu, prayer, and the basics. There are no wrong answers.

two.title: Get your stage and a path
two.body: We place you in one of three stages and choose the path that fits where you are now.

three.title: Learn one short lesson at a time
three.body: Each lesson takes a few minutes, and your path always shows you what comes next.

paths.title: Paths for every stage
paths.lead: Each path belongs to a stage, and each step builds on the one before it.

mentor.title: You are not alone
mentor.body: You can ask for a mentor: a volunteer, an experienced Muslim, matched with you by our team. Bring any question, big or small, and learn with someone beside you.

stories.title: Stories from new Muslims
stories.lead: Their first steps, in their own words.

final.title: Start where you are
final.body: Six short questions, about one minute. Your first lesson will be waiting at the end.
